brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:c130ab96-5b43-4196-8.title: Associate Project Manager, DFR Implementation
brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:c130ab96-5b43-4196-8.description: ABOUT BRINC: At BRINC, we are redefining public safety with an innovative ecosystem of life-saving tools. Our journey started with the development of drones and ruggedized throw phones, designed to access unsafe areas and establish communication to de-escalate situations. Today, we've expanded into creating and deploying 911 response networks, where drones are dispatched to 911 calls to provide real-time visual data, enhancing safety and enabling de-escalation-focused responses. Our cutting-edge solutions are utilized by over 600 public safety agencies across America and the company has raised over $150M from investors, including Index Ventures, Motorola Solutions, Sam Altman, Dylan Field, Mike Volpe, Alexandr Wang and more. At BRINC, we are committed to recruiting the world's best talent to join us in our mission to support first responders in saving lives. ABOUT THIS ROLE: BRINC is seeking a dynamic and proactive person to fill the role of Associate Project Manager, DFR Implementation to manage the overall implementation of our Drone as a First Responder (DFR) solution. This role interacts with a customer upon a sales booking and manages the customers’ program rollout from onboarding to go-live. The ideal candidate should possess exceptional leadership, communication, and organizational skills, experience in managing complex projects with a preference for those with significant nuanced experience in the public safety sector. This role will have up to a 65% travel commitment to engage with customers on-site, prior to, during and post implementation. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Planning, managing and rollout of BRINC’s DFR ecosystem - Implement project plans, define milestones, manage timelines for the deployment and scaling of BRINC’s DFR & other solutions - Develop and maintain strong relationships with our customers in the public safety sector to drive customer success and satisfaction. - Proactively engage with customers to understand their needs, provide timely service, and address any issues or concerns during implementation. - Schedule and conduct ongoing meetings, track performance & provide feedback to both customers and internal stakeholders - Travel to customer sites to include, leading customer meetings, site surveys, Air Traffic Control meetings, FAA Waiver coordination, Implementation & Live Rollout - Ensure alignment and compliance with all relevant guidelines and standards - Ensure the project complies with building codes, aviation, safety, and data privacy regulations, coordinating with the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and other regulatory authorities. - Stay informed of the latest advancements in drone technology & FAA Rules and Regulations QUALIFICATIONS: - Exceptional Communication & Organizational Skills - Proactive and results-oriented work ethic - Ability to multitask effectively - Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and drive actionable insights - Knowledge of Google Earth mapping functionality or similar software - Knowledge of the Google Office Automation suite or similar software - Ability to travel up to 65% of the time - Ability to independently book and manage all aspects of travel, including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and itineraries. - Live within 1.5 hours of a major airport PREFERRED SKILLS: - Operational Experience with DFR and/or Public Safety Drone Programs - Operational experience as a First Responder or Public Safety Sector - Technical Proficiency in Drone Hardware and Software - Computer & Networking knowledge with the ability to communicate requirements with CIOs, IT Leaders, etc - Knowledge of the FAA Waiver Process - Computer & Networking knowledge with the ability to communicate requirements with CIOs, IT Leaders, etc BRINC CULTURE VALUES: - Try the hard stuff - Be innovative - Invent the future - Move fast - Listen to end-users - Strive for excellence - Don’t build a dystopia - Be frugal - Save lives through technology If you’re interested

jobgether-jobgether:lever:17a33579-b3bd-.title: Head of Data Center Design
jobgether-jobgether:lever:17a33579-b3bd-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Data Center Design based in France. As Head of Data Center Design, you will take ownership of the technical vision and architecture for a major next-generation AI data center development in Europe. You’ll lead design decisions across power, cooling, IT infrastructure, fire protection, networking, and structural considerations. The role offers significant technical influence, from early site feasibility and concept development through detailed engineering and construction execution. You’ll establish the Basis of Design and ensure that multidisciplinary teams remain aligned with performance, capacity, efficiency, and reliability objectives. Working with technology partners and implementation teams, you’ll ensure approved designs translate effectively into real-world infrastructure. The environment is international, technically complex, and focused on large-scale, high-density compute infrastructure. This is an opportunity to shape a critical infrastructure project designed to support the rapidly growing demands of AI and advanced computing. Own the overall technical design, architecture, and engineering vision for large-scale data center facilities. Define and maintain the Basis of Design , covering modular POD architecture, cooling strategy, power topology, fire suppression, networking, and other critical infrastructure requirements. Establish design standards for IT deployment, including rack layouts, containerization approaches, and CDU placement. Lead multidisciplinary design reviews and approve engineering drawings across electrical, mechanical, structural, fire protection, and networking disciplines. Establish and monitor design-stage targets for PUE, capacity, availability, redundancy, and reliability . Coordinate with equipment manufacturers, technology providers, and engineering partners on technical specifications and integration requirements. Work closely with implementation and construction teams to ensure that physical execution remains aligned with the approved design intent. Assess and approve proposed design changes, evaluating their potential impact on cooling, power, capacity, redundancy, performance, and reliability. Lead technical criteria for site selection and feasibility assessments, including power availability, grid connectivity, cooling options, and other infrastructure considerations. Provide technical leadership throughout the design lifecycle and ensure consistent engineering standards across projects and disciplines. Requirements 5+ years of experience in data center design or in the design of critical infrastructure, industrial, energy, or similarly complex facilities ; direct data center experience is highly valued but not mandatory. Demonstrated ownership of, or significant contribution to, Basis of Design documentation for large-scale facilities. At least 3 years of experience in a design leadership or technical leadership position. Strong technical knowledge of power distribution/topology and cooling strategies , with sufficient working knowledge of fire suppression and structural loading to coordinate effectively across disciplines. Proven experience leading multidisciplinary design reviews and reviewing or approving engineering drawings across multiple technical trades. Strong ability to translate technical requirements into clear design standards, decisions, and execution requirements. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with engineering teams, technology partners, suppliers, and construction teams. Professional English proficiency sufficient for international technical documentation, meetings, and stakeholder communication. jobgether-jobgether:lever:35f3624e-f620-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Marketing based in India. This is a senior marketing leadership opportunity for an experienced strategist ready to shape growth across multiple business lines and markets. You will own the development and execution of an integrated marketing strategy spanning brand, acquisition, retention, and performance. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on oversight of SEO, PPC, CRM, content, social media, email, digital PR, partnerships, and sponsorships. You will work closely with sales and business development to connect marketing activity directly to commercial outcomes. Success will require a strong command of data, ROI optimization, and customer acquisition alongside the ability to build compelling brands. You will also lead distributed, cross-functional teams and help identify new opportunities for international expansion. Develop and execute a unified marketing strategy across B2B and B2C business lines, aligning marketing priorities with broader commercial objectives. Lead brand positioning, customer acquisition, retention, and performance marketing initiatives across multiple channels and markets. Optimize marketing budgets and channel performance through rigorous measurement, analytics, experimentation, and ROI-focused decision-making. Oversee SEO, PPC, paid social, email marketing, CRM, content marketing, digital PR, and marketing automation programs to drive sustainable growth. Build and implement lead-generation strategies that strengthen the pipeline and support sales and business development teams. Recruit, mentor, and manage cross-functional marketing teams covering areas such as content, social media, paid media, events, and partnerships. Foster strong collaboration between marketing, sales, and business development to ensure shared priorities, clear targets, and measurable revenue impact. Lead sponsorships, expos, industry events, and strategic partnerships that increase market visibility and create new business opportunities. Strengthen the global brand presence by identifying emerging markets, channels, partnerships, and opportunities for expansion. Represent the organization at relevant industry events, conferences, networking opportunities, and other high-value business forums. Requirements 5+ years of experience in senior marketing leadership positions such as Head of Marketing, VP of Marketing, CMO, or an equivalent role. Strong experience in iGaming, affiliate marketing, performance marketing, or closely related digital industries. Deep understanding of both B2B and B2C marketing strategies, particularly within fast-moving digital businesses. Proven success in performance marketing, marketing analytics, budget management, and optimizing campaigns for measurable ROI. Strong knowledge of SEO, PPC, CRM, content marketing, social media, email marketing, digital PR, and related growth channels. Demonstrated experience developing lead-generation and sales enablement strategies that contribute directly to business development. Strong leadership and people-management skills, with experience managing remote and cross-functional teams. Ability to combine creative brand thinking with strong commercial judgment and a data-driven approach. Excellent strategic planning, communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills. Hands-on experience with paid social, sponsorships, partnerships, expos, and industry events is an advantage. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities, and taking ownership of global marketing initiatives. Benefits Competitive salary with performance-related bonuses. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c95fbe4a-9d09-.title: Social Media Manager for X
jobgether-jobgether:lever:c95fbe4a-9d09-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Social Media Manager for X based in South Africa. This is an opportunity to become the voice of a fast-growing crypto platform on X and play a central role in shaping its presence within Crypto Twitter. You will monitor conversations, trends, memes, and breaking news to identify opportunities for timely and engaging content. The role combines community management, social copywriting, content creation, and hands-on engagement with users and industry voices. You will work closely with marketing and product teams to bring campaigns to life while maintaining a distinctive and authentic brand voice. The ideal candidate is deeply immersed in crypto culture, understands how online communities communicate, and knows what makes content resonate. You will have significant creative ownership and the opportunity to help define how a widely used crypto product participates in the conversation. This role is suited to a social-native professional who thrives in a fast-moving environment and can move quickly when the feed demands it. Monitor X trends, conversations, breaking news, memes, competitors, and influential accounts to identify opportunities for timely and relevant content. Build and maintain an active presence within the Crypto Twitter community through thoughtful, entertaining, and strategic replies. Develop relationships with influencers, creators, brands, users, and other relevant members of the crypto ecosystem. Create engaging social content that reflects the brand voice, communicates product value, and resonates with the target community. Collaborate with marketing and product teams to translate product launches, campaigns, and initiatives into compelling content for X. Develop social copy, memes, and other creative formats designed to increase engagement, awareness, and community participation. Stay highly responsive to rapidly developing conversations and news, adapting working hours when necessary to capitalize on important moments. Contribute ideas and expertise across broader marketing initiatives where additional strengths in content, social, or creative marketing can add value. Help continuously refine the brand's voice, tone, and social media strategy based on community feedback, performance, and emerging trends. Requirements Deep understanding of social media platforms, trends, formats, and community-building principles. Strong knowledge of cryptocurrency, blockchain, and Crypto Twitter culture, with genuine familiarity with the community and its language. Demonstrated experience building, managing, or actively engaging a social media following on X. Strong social copywriting skills and the ability to create concise, entertaining, culturally relevant content. Experience creating memes and understanding the formats, humor, references, and conventions that perform well within online crypto communities. Strong awareness of current crypto narratives, influential personalities, projects, communities, and industry developments. Ability to identify opportunities quickly and respond to fast-moving conversations without compromising quality or brand alignment. Strong communication, creativity, judgment, and community engagement skills. Ability to work independently, take ownership, and adapt priorities in a rapidly changing environment. Basic graphic design and video editing skills are a plus. Experience creating content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Reddit, or other social platforms is a plus. Additional marketing capabilities, such as content writing or broader content strategy, are also welcome. Benefits Opportunity to take ownership of the X presence and voice of a growing crypto platform. Exposure to a fast-moving international crypto environment and a large, engaged user community. jobgether-jobgether:lever:ef5f5a69-41be-.title: Analista de FP&A Sênior
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ef5f5a69-41be-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analista de FP&A Sênior based in Brazil. This is a senior financial planning and analysis role with broad exposure to business performance, strategic planning, and executive decision-making. You will lead key budgeting, forecasting, and long-term planning processes while translating financial data into actionable business insights. The role combines financial modeling, scenario analysis, performance tracking, and close collaboration with commercial and operational teams. You will monitor critical indicators such as revenue, bookings, margin, and EBITDA, identifying risks and opportunities that can influence business outcomes. You will also contribute to pricing, profitability, investment, and growth initiatives in a dynamic technology-oriented environment. This is an opportunity for an experienced FP&A professional to have meaningful impact in a remote, international organization. Lead the annual budget, periodic forecasting, and long-term financial planning processes. Monitor actual results against budgets and forecasts, analyzing variances and identifying key risks, opportunities, and performance drivers. Track and analyze business KPIs, including revenue, bookings, margin, EBITDA, and recurring-business metrics. Build and maintain financial models, business cases, and scenario analyses to support strategic and operational decision-making. Prepare management reports, financial analyses, dashboards, and executive presentations for local and international leadership. Support monthly and quarterly business performance reviews, providing clear insights and recommendations. Partner closely with Marketing, Product, Operations, and other business teams to evaluate growth and profitability initiatives. Assess the financial feasibility and expected returns of new projects, products, investments, and strategic initiatives. Contribute to pricing strategy discussions and identify opportunities to optimize margins and profitability. Translate complex financial information into clear, objective recommendations for senior stakeholders. Support continuous improvements in FP&A processes, reporting, forecasting methodologies, and financial planning practices. Collaborate effectively with international teams and contribute to a consistent, data-driven approach to business performance management. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Solid professional experience in FP&A, financial planning, management control, or a comparable finance function. Strong hands-on experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and financial modeling. Advanced Excel skills, with the ability to build and analyze complex financial models and datasets. Fluent English, with the ability to communicate and collaborate regularly with international teams. Strong analytical capabilities, attention to detail, and a structured approach to problem-solving. Excellent communication skills, particularly the ability to present financial analyses and recommendations clearly and objectively to business stakeholders. Familiarity with recurring-business and SaaS metrics such as MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, and related performance indicators. Experience in technology or SaaS companies is a strong advantage. Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or other business intelligence and data visualization tools is a plus. Knowledge of SQL for data analysis is desirable. Experience working in multinational or globally distributed organizations is an advantage. Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-paced business environment. Benefits: 100% remote position in Brazil. summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment isnot a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Commissions are paid every pay period - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek high-energy personalities that thrive in a fast-paced environment to provide a welcoming atmosphere for our Unlimited Wash Pass Members and a memorable first impression on our new car wash guests. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated and have an outgoing, friendly personality. All we ask is for you to share our passion for washing cars, creating memorable moments, and our obsession with exceptional guest service!
